ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Prohibitions in Islam Zina? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prohibitions in Islam Zina.
   B. Say Prohibitions in Islam Zina has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Prohibitions in Islam Zina to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prohibitions in Islam Zina with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith.
   B. Use Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith has no place in daily life.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

5. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in the Last Day Hellfire.
   B. Use Belief in the Last Day Hellfire to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Belief in the Last Day Hellfire has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Virtues in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam.
   C. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Virtues in Islam has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Islamic Morality? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Significance of Islamic Morality with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Significance of Islamic Morality has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Islamic Morality.
   D. Use Significance of Islamic Morality to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Which response best shows understanding of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 .
   B. Apply the teaching of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat.
   B. Say Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Qadar? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Qadar to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Qadar with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Qadar.
   D. Say Belief in Qadar has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Issues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Kenya 07 7.2 Unity of Muslims 04 7.3 Muslim Institutions 09 Total Numbe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Kenya Eastern Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Unity of Muslims and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
